services.name: Tally Mountain Golf Course
services.desc: The 18-hole “Tally Mountain” course at the Tally Mountain Golf Course facility in Tallapoosa, Georgia features 6,874 yards of golf from the longest tees for a par of 72. The course rating is 70.0 and it has a slope rating of 125 on Bermuda grass. The course offers terrific views and challenging play for golfers at every level. Designed by Arthur L. Davis, ASGCA/Joseph L. Lee, the Tally Mountain golf course opened in 1963. Kassidy Craft manages the course as the superintendent. - Inside city limits $65.00- Outside city limits $75.00- (Does not include cart fees.) Monday - Friday (Non-Member) 9 holes w/cart - $35 18 holes w/cart - $45 Green fee - $25 Senior Golf Discounts Monday- Friday
